title: Android EMI Payment Locker
desc:
I need an Android-only locker application that can remotely lock a customer’s phone whenever an EMI payment is missed. The lock itself will be triggered manually from an admin dashboard once my finance team confirms non-payment; there is no need for automated date checks on the device.  

Core flow: the customer installs the app during onboarding, grants all required device-owner permissions, and keeps it running quietly in the background. If a payment is missed, I log in to the web-based admin panel, select the user’s device, and send the lock command. The device should then display a full-screen blocking view that prevents normal use until I issue an unlock command after payment is received.  

Because the sole purpose is payment enforcement, traditional locker extras such as file storage, password managers, or photo vaults are not required. Instead, I want the build to focus on: reliable remote locking, tamper resistance (e.g., uninstall protection, block Settings access), and a lightweight footprint so the customer’s phone performance is unaffected when the device is in good standing.  

Please deliver:  
• Android app (targeting current API level with backward compatibility to Android 8)  
• Secure admin web panel or small REST service with simple UI to lock/unlock users  
• Documentation covering installation, required permissions (Device Administrator / Device Owner), and the lock-unlock API calls  

A short demo video or screen recording that proves the lock, unlock,

title: Studio Shoot for Apparel Drop
desc:
We need a photographer in Dublin for a concise, one-hour studio session at 50hz Studio on the evening of July 29th to showcase MYTH’s latest apparel drop. The setting is a clean white-room studio where several models will rotate through individual, group, and close-up clothing poses. The resulting images will anchor our upcoming promotional material, and we want a polished, commercially styled look that still feels authentic to an underground music and nightlife brand.

You’ll direct the lighting and composition, shoot tethered if possible so we can review on the spot, and deliver fully edited, high-resolution files ready for print, web, and social. Please tell me about similar commercial work you’ve handled—your experience is the deciding factor for us. We are specifically looking for someone with extensive photo shoot experience, a high-quality camera, and the ability to deliver files in correct formats and ratios.

Key deliverables:  
• Approximately 30–40 final retouched images (mix of portrait, landscape, and detail shots)  
• Colour-corrected, cropped, and exported in both web-optimised and full-res formats within five days of the shoot  

The studio and models are booked; you just bring your camera kit, lighting know-how, and creative eye. Looking forward to seeing how your experience can elevate this drop.

title: Tally Postings for Family Accounts
desc:
I need the last two financial years of my family’s personal accounts posted neatly inside Tally. There are only five to six ledgers involved and, on average, each ledger holds about fifteen transactions per year—so the work is light but must be precise.  

All entries should follow the Standard Tally format so that I can open the file and run my usual reports without extra tweaks. I will supply the raw data (bank statements and notes) in the order you’ll need; you simply key them in, reconcile totals, and share back the updated Tally data file along with a quick PDF export of the ledger and daybook for each year so I can review.  

Accuracy matters more than speed, but I would like both years wrapped up quickly so I can move on to tax preparation. If anything looks off balance, flag it and confirm with me before finalising.

title: Fintech Expense Tracker UI/UX Design
desc:
I’m building a mobile-first productivity app with a clear Fintech twist: it centres on personal expense tracking. I already have a feature list and a rough user flow, but the screens are still only sketches. Your task is to translate those ideas into a clean, intuitive UI and a friction-free UX that makes logging, viewing and analysing daily spending feel effortless.

Here’s what I need from you:  
• Low-fidelity wireframes that map the full expense-tracking journey—from adding receipts to visualising trends.  
• A consistent design system (colour, type, iconography) suitable for light and dark mode.  
• High-fidelity, clickable prototypes in Figma (or Sketch/Adobe XD if you strongly prefer).  
• Handoff-ready assets and style-guides so my developers can implement the designs without guesswork.

Acceptance criteria  
1. Every primary action can be completed within three taps.  
2. Data-heavy screens (charts, summaries) must remain readable on 5.5–6.7" devices.  
3. All components pass WCAG AA contrast ratios.

I’ll share full user stories, branding references and a Trello board once we start. If you’re a fresh designer eager to showcase solid mobile Fintech skills, this project will give you a polished portfolio piece.

title: Lead Generation Landing Domains
desc:

• Responsive, modern & clean design, fast load times  
• Contact form on every page, routed to our chosen email/CRM  
• Single CTA: “Schedule a consultation,” with event tracking in Ad Manager

• Final hand-off with all source files and login credentials

title: Screen-Recorded Tutorial Videos for Routella
desc:
## Project Title

**Create Clear Screen-Recorded How-To Videos for a SaaS App**

## Project Description

We are looking for an experienced tutorial video creator and editor to produce a series of short, professional **how-to videos for our web application, Routella**.

Routella is a delivery-management and route-planning platform. The purpose of these videos is to help new users quickly understand how to use each feature of the app.

Each video should focus on **one specific feature or workflow** and explain it in a very simple, clear, and easy-to-follow way.

### What the videos should include

* High-quality screen recordings of the application
* Clear, step-by-step explanations in simple English
* Professional English voice-over
* Smooth and easy-to-follow cursor movement
* Zooming in on important buttons, fields, and sections
* Highlighting or spotlighting the area currently being explained
* Dimming, blurring, or shadowing less relevant parts of the screen when helpful
* Simple arrows, boxes, callouts, or short text labels where necessary
* Removal of mistakes, loading times, unnecessary pauses, and repetitive actions
* Light transitions and clean editing
* Optional subtitles or captions
* Consistent visual style across all videos

The editing should remain clean and professional. We are **not looking for heavy animation or complicated effects**. The most important thing is that every video is easy to understand, even for someone using the application for the first time.

title: Stock Psychology Article Series
desc:

I need at least ten pieces, each 800–1,200 words, written in a casual, conversational voice that feels welcoming to newcomers yet remains factually solid and well researched.

Once outlines are approved, you’ll create the full articles, weaving in everyday language, relatable anecdotes, and practical takeaways that help readers connect emotional biases to real trading situations. Every article should open with an engaging hook, progress through clearly labelled sections, and close with a concise, actionable summary.

Visual support matters: incorporate royalty-free images or simple illustrations where they genuinely enhance understanding of a point or concept (no need for heavy data graphics).

Deliverables

title: North India Medical Facilities List
desc:

• Capture, at minimum, the facility name, full postal address, city, contact phone, email (if available), ownership type (public / private / charitable) and any accreditation noted in the source.  
• Present the final data in both Excel and CSV so it is ready for import into our internal system; please keep one row per facility and use consistent column headers.  

Acceptance criteria  
1. All three states (Punjab, Haryana, Uttar Pradesh) are represented.  
2. Each facility is categorised correctly as Hospital, Nursing home or Clinic.  
3. No obvious duplicates; basic deduplication checks should be performed.  
4. File passes a quick spot-check of 30 random entries against the original source links you provide in a separate “Sources” sheet.  

If you already maintain a similar database, let me know—speed is welcome as long as accuracy is maintained.

title: Accurate PDF Text Transcription
desc:

Accuracy is essential: spelling, punctuation, and paragraph breaks must match the source. You may run the files through OCR if it speeds you up, but I will only accept work that has been fully proof-read and is free of errors or odd characters that automated tools sometimes introduce.

Please let me know:
• How many PDF pages you can handle per day  
• The text format you prefer to deliver (Word, Google Docs, or plain text)

Deliverables
• Clean, error-free text files corresponding to each PDF  
• A brief progress note at agreed checkpoints  
• Final batch review confirming all pages are complete and accurate  

If this sounds like a good fit, tell me your availability and turnaround time so we can get started right away.

Through his integrity and vision he rallies city youths, channels their energy into the temple project, and sparks a wider movement that reshapes cultural attitudes across the nation.

Smooth pacing, relatable characters and a satisfying emotional arc are essential.

Deliverables

title: .NET Web App Pen Test

What I expect to receive  
1. A concise executive summary describing overall risk.  
2. A technical report that lists each finding with:

3. A short debrief call or recorded walkthrough clarifying critical items.

Acceptance criteria

title: Harden Python App Against Reverse-Engineering
desc:
I’m ready to move beyond basic protections and put my cross-platform Python application (Windows desktop and Raspberry Pi) through a true white-box security test. My main objectives are:

• See whether you can bypass the current access-control logic and gain unauthorized privileges.  
• Break any encryption I’ve put around sensitive user data.  
• Defeat the obfuscation layers and integrity checks I’ve added, showing me exactly where the weak points lie.

Once you succeed (or if you prove the existing controls hold), I need a clear, reproducible report that covers:

1. The exact steps, tooling, and scripts you used to reverse-engineer or tamper with the code.  
2. Proof-of-concept exploits, demo videos or screenshots, plus any modified binaries/scripts.  
3. Recommendations and sample patches—preferably illustrating stronger integrity-checking, better key management for encryption, and hard-to-diffuse obfuscation techniques (PyArmor, Cython compilation, signature verification, etc.).  

Acceptance criteria  
• At least one verifiable breach attempt documented end-to-end, or a justified explanation of why no breach was possible.  
• A remediation plan I can apply and test to confirm the same attack vector no longer works.  

I’ll handle deployment; you just need to deliver the exploit artifacts and the remediation blueprint. Looking forward to seeing how deep you can dig and how we can lock it all back down.

Deliverables  
• One consolidated PDF (or Google Doc) that covers:  
  – Dosha-based rationale for each choice  
  – Seven-day sample menu with adjustments for seasonality  
  – Morning-to-evening routine outline highlighting energy-enhancing habits  
  – Suggested herbal formulations or over-the-counter preparations, plus dosage and sourcing tips

title: Tron dApp Debug & Integration -- 2
desc:
I already have a deployed smart contract, polished UI files, and a working codebase, but logical errors are blocking the full flow. The dApp must run smoothly inside Trust Wallet, so it needs to:

• connect to the user’s Tron wallet,  
• check the connected wallet’s energy,  
• delegate energy automatically through the Catfee endpoints if the balance is too low, and  
• sign and broadcast the raw transaction that interacts with my contract.

Right now the logical issue touches every step—wallet connection, energy check, and the final signing—so I need a developer who can read the current JavaScript/TypeScript code, trace the faulty logic, and deliver a clean, tested solution that behaves consistently on both mobile and desktop versions of Trust Wallet.

Deliverables  
1. Corrected source code with clear comments on each fix.  
2. Working Catfee delegation call integrated into the energy-check routine.  
3. Verified transaction signing that completes without manual intervention.  
4. Short README explaining setup, build commands, and any new dependencies.

I will provide:  
• Figma screens and existing front-end assets.  
• Current repository access and contract ABI.  
• Test accounts for end-to-end validation.

Please let me know your experience with TronWeb, wallet providers inside Trust Wallet, and any similar dApps you have shipped. I’m ready to start as soon as the approach and timeline are clear.

title: High-Speed Drone Airframe Design
desc:
I’m developing a fixed-wing unmanned aircraft that must cruise comfortably above 200 knots with a 14 hp pusher prop engine. The finished platform will lift 30–35 kg at take-off, yet the bare airframe (clean fuselage and wings ) must not exceed 12–15 kg.  

High-speed stability is the single most important design driver. The layout also has to accommodate:  
• a surveillance-grade gimbal camera ahead of the CG,  (approx size of bay is 200mm x 200mm)
• Room for retractable undercarriage 
• an 8 L fuel tank near the wing box, and  
• a fully accessible avionics bay built around modular compartments so future sensors can be swapped in without re-cutting the structure.  


To reach the target drag numbers I will need a full aerodynamic package: CFD-level lofting, airfoil selection, lift-to-drag optimisation, and flutter margins for the 200 kt envelope. Please include AI-driven “wind-tunnel” testing or surrogate modelling so we can iterate virtually before we cut any moulds.  

Deliverables  
1. 3-D CAD of fuselage, wing and empennage ready for manufacture (STEP + native file)  
2. Aerodynamic report: lift/drag curves, pressure maps, stability derivatives, flutter check  
3. AI-assisted virtual wind-tunnel dataset with training method documented  
4. Weight breakdown and structural justification showing the 12–15 kg airframe target  
5. Integration drawings for the gimbal, 8 L tank, and modular avionics bay  
6. Brief build manual highlighting materials, lay-ups or machining specs

title: Residential Generator Room Noise Analysis
desc:
I need a precise acoustic calculation for a small residential generator room whose main goal is straightforward: cut the noise to a far more neighbour-friendly level. The assessment should quantify existing sound pressure levels, model how the noise propagates through the surrounding structure, and then translate those figures into practical solutions.

Two measures matter most to me:
• Soundproofing the walls with the right combination of mass-loaded barriers, insulation and damping layers.  
• Selecting and sizing suitable silencers or mufflers for both intake and exhaust paths.

Please base the study on accepted acoustic-engineering methods (e.g., octave-band analysis, ISO/IEC guidelines) and express results in dB(A). I expect a clear, readable report that includes:

1. All input data and assumptions (generator make/model, room dimensions, construction materials).  
2. Calculated baseline noise at key receiver points.  
3. Predicted noise levels after each proposed treatment.  
4. A bill of recommended materials/equipment with installation notes.

Deliver the final document in PDF plus the native calculation sheet (Excel or similar) so I can tweak parameters later if needed. Let me know any additional information you require about the generator or room before you begin, and please outline your expected timeline in your proposal.

title: Daily kWh Logging From Digital Meters
desc:
I have several digital energy meters on-site and need an automated way to capture their cumulative kWh reading once every 24 hours, then write that figure into a database with the date-time stamp.  

Here is what I have in mind:  

• Data capture – a script or small application that polls each meter at the same time every day, pulls the total kWh value, and resets or stores any required registers without disturbing normal operation.  
• Storage – the reading should be inserted into a database table (MySQL, PostgreSQL, or SQLite are all acceptable; choose the engine you feel is most appropriate and note any advantages).  
• Scheduling – the task must run reliably every 24 h, either through a built-in scheduler, cron, or a lightweight Windows service.  
• Resilience – if a read fails, the job should retry gracefully and log the error so I can trace issues later.  
• Handover – provide the source code, a simple database schema, and a step-by-step setup guide so I can redeploy or extend the solution as more meters come online.

Please build the solution in the language and toolchain you are most comfortable with (Python with pymodbus, Node.js with SerialPort, or similar are all fine) as long as the final setup remains lightweight and easy to maintain. Once delivered, I will test it on my meters for a full week; acceptance is complete when each day’s reading appears in the database without gaps or duplicates.

Robust risk controls—hard stops, trailing stops, daily loss limits—are essential.

Core requirements  
• Clean, well-commented AFL code that compiles without errors in the current AmiBroker release  
• Portfolio-level back-testing and walk-forward optimisation reports demonstrating edge for both strategies on Stocks and Forex data

• Parameter sheet or GUI panel for quick tweaks without touching the source

​Hardware Integration: Model the mouth of the weight pockets to accept standard brass heat-set inserts and flush hex socket screws.
​Target: Designed to achieve a 350g–360g raw head weight.

title: Animated YouTube Tutorial Video Creation
desc:
Refering existing YouTube animation that I’d like to use as a creative benchmark, but I need a fresh 2D version that is unmistakably mine. The goal is to produce a concise tutorial-style video that walks viewers through the steps of my service while steadily building brand recognition.

Here is what I need you to weave in:

• My logo featured prominently at the open and close, plus a tasteful on-screen placement throughout.  
• Clear text overlays that highlight each key instruction.  
• Light, engaging character animation that keeps the pace lively without distracting from the message.  
• A friendly, well-paced voice-over (English) that matches the on-screen flow. I’ll supply the final script or collaborate with you on edits if you prefer.  
• Seamless inclusion of my contact details in the end slate and a lower-third pop-up.  

Final deliverables: the mastered video in 1080p ready for immediate upload, and the editable project/source files (Illustrator/After Effects or equivalent). Please confirm your experience with 2D animation and voice-over sync when you reply, and share one or two links to similar tutorial animations you’ve completed.

Once we agree on the timeline, I’ll send the reference link and brand assets so you can get started right away.

title: Commission Sales & Marketing Intern
desc:
I run Pratibimb AI, an agency that turns long-form expertise from doctors, founders and real-estate agents into short, high-impact AI-generated videos and reels. To accelerate our reach I am opening a remote, performance-based internship.

How you will create impact  
You will identify prospects in the three niches above, start conversations and move them through the funnel until they book a paid content package. Cold email and phone outreach are the primary channels I rely on today; cold calls, DMs or any other creative route are welcome as long as they convert.

Compensation & structure  
The internship itself is unpaid, but each successful client you bring in earns you ₹5,000 immediately after the invoice is cleared. Work whenever you like, from wherever you like, provided the pipeline keeps moving.

Deliverables I expect  
• A weekly spreadsheet (Google Sheets) listing new leads, contact attempts and conversation status  
• Call or email templates you refine over time  
• A quick summary of lessons learned every fortnight so we can tweak the outreach playbook together

Acceptance criteria  
A lead is considered “converted” once the client signs up for a paid Pratibimb AI video package and the first payment lands. That event triggers your commission.

If building real-world sales skills while helping professionals grow their personal brands excites you, message me with a short note on how you would open a cold email to a doctor.

title: Blog Post Translation & Writing
desc:
I have a series of existing documents that need to be turned into engaging blog posts and, where necessary, translated so they read naturally for an online audience. The raw material is already written; what I need is a writer-translator who can reshape each piece into a concise, well-structured post while adapting the language faithfully into the target version.

Here is what the work looks like:
• Review the source document and identify the key message.  
• Translate the content accurately, preserving tone and nuance.  
• Rewrite the translated text into a blog-friendly format with clear headings, smooth flow, and an inviting introduction and conclusion.  
• Deliver a polished, ready-to-publish blog post for each document.

You are free to work in the word processor or CMS you are most comfortable with—Google Docs, Word, or directly in WordPress are all fine by me—as long as the final copy is error-free and publication-ready.

Send a brief note highlighting your language pair(s), a link to one or two blog posts you have already authored or translated, and your expected turnaround per 1,000 words. I’ll share the first document immediately so we can start.

title: Lead Generation for Custom 3D Prototyping
desc:
I run a 3D printing business producing custom parts, prototypes, and branded/promotional items. I'm looking for someone to generate qualified sales leads — this is a paid pilot batch of 10 leads, with ongoing monthly work available if the results are good.

What counts as a qualified lead:

Real business or individual with a genuine need for custom 3D printing (prototypes, promotional items, branded merchandise, small production runs, replacement/custom parts, etc.)
Contacted directly (email or LinkedIn) and responded confirming interest
Provided at least a basic description of what they need (not just "sounds interesting, send info")

What I need delivered:
A spreadsheet (Google Sheet or Excel) with, per lead:

Company/contact name
Contact info (email/LinkedIn)
What they need (brief description)
Date contacted
Confirmation of interest (quote/response summary)

Payment terms:
$5.00 per qualified lead meeting the criteria above, paid as a fixed-price milestone for the batch of 10 ($50 total). Leads that don't meet the qualification bar (no response, vague interest, unrelated industry) won't count toward the batch.

Good fit if you have:

B2B outreach or cold email/LinkedIn experience
Familiarity with small business, manufacturing, prototyping, or e-commerce sales
Can work independently with minimal oversight

Please include examples of past lead gen work in your proposal.

title: Rapid 20 Page Copy Typing
desc:
I have a set of about 20 pages that must be retyped quickly and accurately. You will receive the existing sample pages and your task is to reproduce the text in a fresh, clean document using standard formatting—nothing fancy, just proper paragraphs, line breaks, and consistent font size. Spelling, punctuation, and line order must stay exactly as in the original sample.

Once done, send back a Word or Google Docs file so I can review and sign off. Speed is important, but accuracy is critical; please be confident in both before you accept.

title: Naruto-Style 2D Product Animation
desc:
I need a short, punchy anime clip—15 to 20 seconds—that showcases my product through dynamic, Naruto-inspired action. I already have reference material with the finalized character designs for both the main and supporting characters, so you’ll be fleshing out their movements and the surrounding action based on those visuals. 

What I’m counting on you for is the smooth, high-impact choreography, fluid camera moves, and the clean line-work typical of Studio Pierrot’s classic episodes. You can expect me to supply the reference sheets, rough scene notes, and a clear description of the product’s role in the clip; you’ll handle timing, key poses, in-betweens, effects, colouring, and compositing until we reach a polished, broadcast-ready result.

Please share links to comparable anime sequences you have animated—especially any high-speed fight cuts or power-up scenes—so I can gauge style fit. I’ll review rough storyboards or animatics first, then green-light full production. Final delivery should include the mastered 1080p (or higher) video, plus source project files so I can archive them for future updates.

If tight, fluid action is your specialty and you love channeling that late-90s shōnen energy, let’s bring this mini-episode to life.

title: BCom LLB Professional Ethics Exam Notes
desc:
I need a clear, exam-ready package of notes and concise case summaries covering Professional Ethics for a BCom LLB course. The focus is strictly on Confidentiality and the Duty to clients, so every point you include should reinforce one of those two pillars.

The notes themselves must be in tight bullet-point form—think headings, sub-points, and no waffle—so they can double as last-minute revision sheets. For each key case you select, give me three short sections only: (1) brief facts, (2) the core legal principle, and (3) the final outcome. That structure keeps everything uniform and lets me flip through rapidly.

I expect accurate citations, correct legal terminology, and clean formatting (Word or Google Docs is fine). You can pull authorities from standard databases such as Westlaw, LexisNexis, or SCC Online, but be sure the jurisdiction aligns with a common-law Indian context wherever possible.

Deliverables:
• Bullet-point notes on Confidentiality  
• Bullet-point notes on Duty to clients  
• Case summaries for each doctrine, each following the “brief facts – legal principle – outcome” template  
• A quick reference list of all cases and secondary sources used  

Once I can read the file end-to-end in under an hour and feel ready to tackle exam questions on these two topics, we’re done.
